top_violation_types.title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguishers were last serviced in August of 2020.

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers pediatric cpr training expired 09/2023.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies lacked information regarding parent rights.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Waterproof, disposable gloves (26 TAC §747.3803(a)(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing disposable gloves.

top_violation_types.title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The breezeway utilized by children to go outside had a strong cigarette odor.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers (26 TAC §747.3803(a)(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation did not have tweezers in the first aid kit.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Ammunition Kept Separate, Locked and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3505(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Ammunition continues to not be locked separate from the firearms. Per the provider, both the firearms and the ammunition were locked together in the same safe.
